items.title: Team Underdog heads to HYROX London ExCeL
items.summary: Around a dozen Underdog athletes are entered for HYROX London at ExCeL, 2–6 December — off the back of client PBs at Birmingham and Fabien's own race in Nice.
items.take: Twelve athletes on one start line tells you everything about the room. Watch this space.

items.title: Birmingham PBs and a Nice finish
items.summary: A superb Underdog weekend: client pairs posted a personal best and a faultless reverse-split run at HYROX Birmingham while Fabien raced in Nice.
items.take: PBs for the clients, a finish for the coach — the gym had a good weekend.
